sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday afternoon looking to bounce back from their most recent defeat. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though they'll face a struggling Alsager side anchored in the bottom three after just one win all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that presents an opportunity to close the gap on leaders Sandbach; both teams have 10 games played. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth entertain fellow mid-table contenders Eccleshall in a potentially significant clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community seeking to maintain their recent winning form before facing Brereton Social in a midweek fixture on Wednesday. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a battle between mid-table sides, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter winless in their last six matches. Market Drayton Town face in-form New Mills away from home, and Crewe travel to meet Allscott Heath. In the basement, Widnes Town visit Brereton Social on Saturday, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's poorest-performing teams.
